targeted_live_probe_if_behavior_disputed.run_policy: do not run by default; run this component only when the challenged claim depends on its current runtime behavior

component_run_decision_index.reader_rule: Use this index before opening or running component bodies: route/ceiling questions read generated rows first; runtime checks are targeted only when the disputed claim depends on that component's behavior.
component_run_decision_index.row_payload_optimization: shared decision policy, escalation trigger, and trust-floor text is deduplicated into decision_policy_registry; rows carry policy_ref
component_run_decision_index.trust_floor: This index reduces unnecessary runs without lowering the evidence floor; any runtime claim still escalates to the component's owner validator.
